title: OpenUSDT (oUSDT) — Hyperlane Warp Route USDC/USDT Peg Arbitrage
loss_raw: ~410,010 USDC extracted on Ethereum across 8 withdrawals (representative attacker; open vulnerability enabled repeated arbitrage)
root_cause: oUSDT warp route mints oUSDT 1:1 against USDC on Base but oUSDT is redeemable 1:1 for native USDT on Celo — USDC/USDT price divergence becomes free arbitrage
steps: (1) Base: deposit N USDC → Hyperlane oUSDT warp route
(2) Bridge oUSDT (Base → Celo) via Hyperlane (cents of gas)
(3) Celo: burn N oUSDT → receive N USDT
